hypothesis_text: Dynamic SBG can detect real software behavioral regressions across versions better than static/structural baselines.
pre_registered_criterion: B07 Dynamic SBG AUROC on regression-vs-equivalent-change classification exceeds the best classical baseline (B02_AST, 0.5528), with statistical significance under permutation testing.

key_numbers.corpus_source: synthetic - no real in-repo or approved public version-history corpus available within scope
key_numbers.negative_finding: B02_AST substantially outperforms B07 Dynamic SBG on this task, opposite of H12's motivating premise
key_numbers.tie_averaging_bug_disclosure: naive compute_auroc() without tie-averaging produced an inflated 0.9515 on this severely-tied corpus; corrected value (0.5706) used throughout this artifact

power_report.interpretation: Genuine non-significance at this N, not merely a small-sample artifact; a larger independently-sourced real-world control corpus remains an open limitation for future work
